hook.text: The fittest species is not the strongest. It is the most adaptable.

buildup.text: Optimization maximizes performance for current conditions. Adaptation maximizes survival across changing conditions.

discovery.text: Cockroaches have survived 300 million years not by being optimal but by being incredibly adaptable to any environment.

twist.text: Over-optimization creates brittleness. A perfectly efficient factory cannot handle a change in demand.

climax.text: Optimize where conditions are stable. Build adaptability where conditions change. Most of life is the second case.

punchline.text: Don't be the best at one thing. Be good enough at everything.

quiz.question: Why can over-optimization be dangerous?
options: It creates systems that perform perfectly but break when conditions change
It takes too long to implement
